Ava Reynolds: Quick heads-up: org change for Product + Platform effective Mon May 5.
Ava Reynolds: Evan Carter is stepping into Head of Product, Platform (formal title) to lead roadmap + customer prioritization. Samir Desai will move from Staff Platform Engineer -> Principal Engineer focused on runtime performance. Both are internal promotions.
Maya Patel: Congrats Evan & Samir! Reporting updates: Evan -> Product leadership (skip-level with CTO), Samir -> Engineering (matrix to Evan for cross-team projects).
Lizzy Mendoza: HR notes: promotions processed, new titles live in Workday. Folks promoted will see comp change on next payroll. Please update your Slack display names if you'd like.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: please accept the career-path confirmation email sent to promoted employees.
Evan Carter: honored to take this on. I'll schedule 1:1s with PMs and set up a biweekly product/platform sync. Open to shadow sessions for anyone running infra experiments.
Samir Desai: excited about the shift. I'll keep working on latency regressions and coordinate with Runtime on kernel tuning.
Ava Reynolds: Hiring note: we'll still recruit for a Principal Backend role to backfill Samir's IC slot; req #PLAT-222 posted today. Interview panel will include Evan and two runtime engineers.
Lizzy Mendoza: We'll run an internal referral email for PLAT-222 this week. If you refer someone who gets hired, referral bonus applies.
Maya Patel: Small ask: teams please update ownership docs and the oncall matrix by EOD Thu so handoffs are smooth. We'll run a quick sync Fri 11am PT to align.
Evan Carter: dropping a short intro doc here later today with priorities for the next 90 days. Looking forward to working with everyone. :rocket:
